chromeos-config: Change '{main,ec,pd}-image' to '{main,ec,pd}-ro-image' To ensure the firmware pushed to auto update is properly tested, we usually identify the qualification test as 'RO' or 'RW-only'. The 'RW-only' tests do not verify some features only available in RO firmware and will be verified together with previously released RO, not the RO in same firmware image. Firmware updater used to support this by having 'main-image' as RO[+RW] and 'main-rw-image' as RW, which people may easily make mistakes by changing 'main-image' even if it's a firmware qualified for RW-only AU. To prevent confusion, we are renaming {main,ec,pd}-image to {main,ec,pd}-ro-image so it is more explicit when a CL is made to push new firmware for AU. There is no {ec,pd}-rw-image because those blobs will be carried by main-rw-image as software sync. {main,ec,pd}-image will be still supported until we've migrated all configs in board overlays. BUG=b:120998415 TEST=./run_tests.sh Change-Id: I6a366575c930fa37ca37ab4010b771a2980588ff Signed-off-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1377791 Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Reviewed-by: Justin TerAvest <teravest@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: C Shapiro <shapiroc@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: drm/i915/gen9, gen10: Disable FBC on planes with a misaligned Y-offset Enabling FBC on a plane having a Y-offset that isn't divisible by 4 may cause pipe FIFO underruns and flickers, so disable FBC on such a config. I tried the followings to work around the issue: - enable each HW work around in ILK_DPFC_CHICKEN - disable each compression algorithm in ILK_DPFC_CONTROL - disable low-power watermarks None of the above got rid of the problem. I haven't found this issue in the Bspec/WA database either. Besides the igt testcase below (yet to be merged) an easy way to reproduce the issue is to enable a plane with FBC and a plane Y-offset not aligned to 4 and then just enable/disable FBC in a loop, keeping the plane enabled. I could trigger the problem on BXT/GLK/SKL/CNL, so assume for now that it's only present on GEN9 and GEN10. v2: (Ville) - Run the test/apply the WA on CNL as well. - Use IS_GEN() instead of INTEL_GEN(). - Fix spelling. BUG= None TEST= Run IGT tests with below commnads, test result should be success ./kms_frontbuffer_tracking --run-subtest fbc-indfb-scaledprimary ./kms_frontbuffer_tracking --run-subtest fbc-shrfb-scaledprimary Cc: Paulo Zanoni <paulo.r.zanoni@intel.com> Cc: Ville Syrjl <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com> Testcase: igt/kms_plane/plane-clipping-pipe-A-planes Signed-off-by: Imre Deak <imre.deak@intel.com> Reviewed-by: Ville Syrjl <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com> Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20180301134457.13974-1-imre.deak@intel.com (cherry picked from commit fee0fddc1dc114039bf9aed9fdeeecdc1949cdc7) Signed-off-by: Kiran Kumar S <kiran.s.kumar@intel.corp-partner.google.com> Change-Id: I9921f781f7c6dec472ae5f1a4430e13745640da2 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1388409 Commit-Ready: Kiran Kumar <kiran.s.kumar@intel.corp-partner.google.com> Tested-by: Anand Naik <anand.naik@intel.corp-partner.google.com> Reviewed-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org>
